title: Counting the Days a Returned Item Was Held, Northbeam Returns and Restocking
content:
The days a Northbeam Returns and Restocking item was held are counted under one of three conventions.

1. Where a prepaid label or collection booking stands on the return and the item was booked in on or after the day the latest of them was issued, the days are counted from the day the return was authorised to the day the item was booked in, so the days it spent travelling back are not counted against the customer.
2. Where no prepaid label or collection booking stands on the return and the item was handed in at a store counter, the days are counted from the day the item was delivered to the day it was booked in and the day of delivery is not counted.
3. In any other case the days are counted from the day the item was delivered to the day it was booked in.

## What each convention reads

| Convention | Conditions, both required where two are given | From | To | The day of delivery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| the first | at least one prepaid label or collection booking stands on the return, and the item was booked in on or after the day the latest of them was issued | the day the return was authorised | the day the item was booked in | not in the count, the count not starting there |
| the second | no prepaid label or collection booking stands on the return, and the item was handed in at a store counter | the day the item was delivered | the day the item was booked in | not counted |
| the third | any other case | the day the item was delivered | the day the item was booked in | counted |

The day compared under the first convention is the day the latest prepaid label or collection booking on the return was issued, and the comparison is satisfied where the item was booked in on that very day as well as after it.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A return authorised on the 10th, one prepaid label issued on the 12th, the item booked in on the 20th.* A label stands on the return and the item came in after the day it was issued, so the first convention applies: from the 10th to the 20th, that is 10 days.

*A return whose item was delivered on the 1st, one collection booking issued on the 14th, the item booked in on the 14th.* The item was booked in on the very day the latest booking was issued, so the first convention still applies.

*A return with no label and no collection booking, the item delivered on the 1st and handed in at a store counter on the 6th.* The second convention applies: from the 1st to the 6th is 5 days, and the day of delivery is not counted, so 4 days.

*A return with no label and no collection booking, the item delivered on the 1st and booked in at the returns centre on the 6th.* Neither of the first two conventions holds, so the third applies and the days are 5.
